neighbours.label: the pieces 'aring'/'ared'/'ptic' after the ' se' prefix token (searing, seared, septic)
fire: Start by searing the beef on all sides in a heavy pan.
He described a searing headache that lasted all night.
The searing heat of July kept everyone indoors.
We ordered seared tuna with a sesame crust.
The duck breast was seared and then rested for five minutes.
Lightly seared scallops came on a bed of peas.
Doctors feared the cut had turned septic overnight.
The old house still drains into a septic tank in the garden.
quiet: Start by browning the beef on all sides in a heavy pan.
He described a pounding headache that lasted all night.
The intense heat of July kept everyone indoors.
We ordered grilled tuna with a sesame crust.
The duck breast was roasted and then rested for five minutes.
Lightly poached scallops came on a bed of peas.
Doctors feared the cut had turned infected overnight.
The old house still drains into a sewage tank in the garden.

notes: Layer 0; the card flags it broad (1.7%). Probe: searing 0.92/0.90, seared 0.86, septic 0.67, ' wake' 0.44, fl|aring 0.24 (so 'aring' works partly without 'se'); frying/roasted/infected/disturb 0.01-0.09. ' wake' is left out of the label to keep it to one spelling pattern.
